text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's too bad. At least you tried.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't think it's just skill but the positioning of the plushies and the strength of the claw that contribute to the game's difficulty.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What I mean to say is, don't feel bad about it. It's not your fault.
